text:
Maya (payments): Noticed a weird spike: three vendor vouchers for "VENDOR-ORBIT" posted within 2s of each other from the nightly backfill. Totals match one expected voucher but tripled.
billing-bot: backfill-run complete: id=bf-2026-04-02-02, duration=00:22:13, created_vouchers=3, warnings=1
Omar (reconciler): Can you paste the voucher ids? I see orphaned credits in staging but not prod yet.
Maya (payments): vc_12001, vc_12002, vc_12003. Source job metadata says source=billing-export and webhook_event=null.
Tess (accounting): These are already in the AP ledger. We'll need reversals; please don't auto-run vendor payments today.
Diego (eng-infra): Quick check: backfill worker service used a batched writer. For certain runs the writer's retry handler sends duplicate create calls if the external id header is missing. Working hypothesis: missing X-Ext-Id header for voucher payloads.
Rina (finance-ops): That matches my note from yesterday when we ran an ad-hoc reingest. Any chance the webhook consumer swallowed ext-id?
Diego (eng-infra): Consumer logs show 3 null ext_id events around 02:03:42. I can fetch payloads.
Omar (reconciler): Script to detect duplicates:
```
SELECT voucher_id, vendor, amount, created_at, ext_id
FROM vendor_vouchers
WHERE vendor = 'VENDOR-ORBIT'
AND created_at >= '2026-04-02 02:00'
ORDER BY created_at;
```

Running now.
billing-bot: duplication_detector: found_group=vc_12001,vc_12002,vc_12003 ext_id=null similarity=0.98
Diego (eng-infra): Root cause: when ext_id is null, our de-dup key resolves to timestamp+amount which in the backfill's tight loop produced distinct keys. Fix: fallback to hashing payload body and set ext_id before enqueue. I'll open PR.
Maya (payments): Proposed remediation plan:
- pause vendor payment run
- mark duplicates as "pending-void"
- create reversing voucher for the extras
- notify vendor and accounting
Need Jon for JE threshold release > $2k.
Jon (CFO): Approve reversals and any manual JE up to $10k. Proceed.
Tess (accounting): I'll prepare reversing JEs and schedule a reconciliation. Tag me when vouchers are voided.
Diego (eng-infra): PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/ops/pull/12567 -- adds ext_id injection and stronger idempotency on backfill writer. Deploying to canary now.
Rina (finance-ops): Running void script: /scripts/void-duplicate-vouchers.sh --group vc_12001,vc_12002,vc_12003 --reason "backfill duplicate"
billing-bot: void-script: started run_id=void-2147654321-1
Omar (reconciler): After void, please run the reconciliation query to confirm AP balance.
billing-bot: void-script: completed run_id=void-2147654321-1 voided=2 retained=1 audit_log=/logs/void-2147654321-1
Tess (accounting): Confirmed AP corrected. Notified vendor contact: ops@orbit.example.
Maya (payments): Thanks. Can we add a dashboard alarm for ext_id_missing rate > 0.1% in backfill jobs?
Diego (eng-infra): Yep adding alert: backfill.ext_id_missing > 0.1% -> paging to eng-infra & billing-sre.
Rina (finance-ops): All good here. Please include a short postmortem in the weekly ops sync.
Jon (CFO): Thanks team. Keep the auto-pay paused until next reconciliation signoff.
Maya (payments): Will do.
